returning: detail: recalled from Grand Rapids and will play
away.summary: The Red Wings (6-5-3) are projected to start Daniil Tarasov in goal against the Panthers. John Leonard has been recalled from Grand Rapids and will play, while Jacob Bernard-Docker and Carter Mazur are scratched. Mason Appleton, Marco Kasper, and Albert Johansson are injured, and Dylan Larkin remains suspended without pay amid trade discussions.

returning: detail: will make his first start since Oct. 17 after missing five games with an upper-body injury sustained in practice
home.summary: The Panthers (8-4-2) are projected to start Jacob Markstrom, who returns after missing five games with an upper-body injury. Aleksander Barkov, Brad Marchand, and Jonah Gadjovich remain out with injuries, while Uvis Balinskis, Cole Reinhardt, and Cooper Black are scratched. Florida has won six of its last eight games and sits at 8-4-2.
